name: CIG Raton Basin 2005 Expansion
researcher_notes: Not an existing row: the only Colorado Interstate Gas row is P0168, the whole-system row, and no expansion row exists. A news report from Natural Gas Intelligence on the May 2005 FERC certificate for docket CP05-50 says the project is 102 miles of 16, 20 and 24 inch looping, 1,775 horsepower of added compression at Beaver compressor station in Oklahoma, $61 million, and 104,600 Dth/d of added capacity. Built in Las Animas and Baca counties in Colorado, Morton County in Kansas and Texas County in Oklahoma. Construction started June 2005, with parts in service September 2005 and the rest in November and December 2005. The August 2026 release of the EIA pipeline projects workbook (sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 382) agrees: 102 mi, 104 MMcf/d, status Completed, in service December 2005, cost 60.4 million. EIA and the news report may trace to the same FERC filing, so they are not counted as independent. A Federal Register notice or FERC order for CP05-50 was not found, so the tier is high on one validated source plus the EIA table. Length is new looping, over the 25 km rule. Start and end are taken from the counties, with Colorado in the west and Oklahoma in the east; exact end points and the Kansas pass-through were not found. Capacity is the added capacity, not the system total. Owner was not sourced for this project: the parent row P0168 lists Kinder Morgan, but in 2005 the operator was El Paso, so no Owner value is staged. Route not researched; route type to be unavailable until a route search is done.
